description: This file defines a type alias for an ActionObserver, which is a function that takes a ComponentAction and MessageData as parameters and returns void. It serves as a type declaration for observer functions handling component actions.

methods.name: ActionObserver
methods.description: A type alias for a function that observes component actions with specific message data.

ctags.name: ActionObserver
